Title: Ribbed Knit Dress
Body (HTML): A fine merino rib that skims rather than clings, cut to mid-calf with a soft roll neck. Knitted whole-garment, so there are no side seams to press on you.

Title: Cotton Gauze Shirt
Body (HTML): Double gauze from Albini, washed twice so it arrives soft. Cut generous through the body with a collar that stays open.

Title: Washed Silk Cami
Body (HTML): Sandwashed 19mm silk with adjustable straps and a bias cut that falls straight. Wears under knitwear or on its own.

Title: Pleated Wide Trouser
Body (HTML): A single forward pleat in a soft wool-linen. Cut wide from the hip, finished with a turn-up and a covered waistband.

Title: Shawl Cardigan
Body (HTML): Chunky lambswool with a rolled shawl collar and horn buttons. The thing you put on at six and forget you are wearing.

Title: The Long Overcoat
Body (HTML): Double-faced 24oz melton, unlined through the body so it moves. Cut below the knee with a collar that stands when you turn it up.

Title: The Chore Jacket
Body (HTML): Washed cotton twill with three patch pockets, tacked at every stress point. It creases, and it should.

Title: Cashmere Crew
Body (HTML): Two-ply Cariaggi cashmere knitted in Scotland at a gauge heavy enough to wear on its own.
